claim: On 2026-02-16 Amazon EC2 added nested virtualization: you can run hypervisors such as Hyper-V and KVM inside virtualized (non-bare metal) EC2 instances; previously, customers could only create and manage virtual machines inside bare metal EC2 instances.

evidence.quote: | [Nested virtualization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/amazon-ec2-nested-virtualization.html) | You can run hypervisors, such as Hyper-V and KVM, inside virtualized Amazon EC2 instances. | February 16, 2026 |
Previously, customers could only create and manage virtual machines inside bare metal EC2 instances.

changed.was: could only create and manage virtual machines inside bare metal EC2 instances

note: d060. fr-0059: the old rule is now quoted from the 2026-02-16 What's New post (evidence 1).
